hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 16 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB (held near 250 MHz by power and thermal limits)

proposals.statement: Parents struggle to get information from the school because fee statements are printed and sent home in learners' bags but half never reach parents

evidence.quote: Fee statements are printed every month and sent home in the learners' bags, and half of them never reach the parents.

proposals.statement: Reports are printed, put in envelopes, and sent home but take a week of admin staff's time every term for about nine hundred learners

evidence.quote: Printed, put in envelopes, sent home. For about nine hundred learners that's a week of the admin staff's time every term.

proposals.statement: Notices are sent via WhatsApp broadcast lists and email but broadcast lists fill up, causing parents who change numbers to fall off

evidence.quote: Those go on WhatsApp broadcast lists, and by email. But a broadcast list fills up, so we have five of them now, and parents who change their numbers just fall off.

proposals.statement: Absence notes are handwritten in the learner's homework diary or emailed to the class teacher who may not pass them to the office, leading to cases where learners are marked absent for three days without office awareness

evidence.quote: Handwritten in the learner's homework diary, or an email to the class teacher, who may or may not pass it on to the office. We had a learner marked absent for three days last term and nobody at the office knew why.

proposals.statement: Parents need a place to see what they owe, their child's reports, and school notices, and to report when their child is sick

evidence.quote: One place where a parent can see what they owe, their child's reports and the school's notices, and tell us when their child is sick.

proposals.statement: The school wants to stop printing reports and fee statements to save costs and admin time

evidence.quote: And for us to stop printing. That's a real cost, and a lot of hours.

proposals.statement: The portal must provide the current balance, monthly statement as a PDF, and reference for EFT payment

evidence.quote: The current balance, the monthly statement as a PDF, and the reference to use for EFT.

proposals.statement: The portal must release term reports as PDFs on the same day for all parents without early access

evidence.quote: The term report as a PDF, the same one we print. Released on the same day for everyone. We don't want some families seeing them before others.

proposals.statement: The portal must allow parents to fill in absence notes with reason and dates, and have both class teacher and office see them immediately

evidence.quote: Yes, the reason and the dates, and the class teacher and the office both see it straight away.

proposals.statement: SchoolBase 7 is used for learners, parents, fees, and marks, and can export to CSV and produce report PDFs

evidence.quote: On a server in the admin block. It's SchoolBase 7, from about 2014 I think. It holds the learners, the parents, fees and marks. It can export to CSV, and it produces the report PDFs.

proposals.statement: The portal must be lightweight with small pages and only download PDFs when opened

evidence.quote: So the portal has to be light: small pages, and the PDFs only downloaded when someone actually opens one.

proposals.statement: The portal must be zero-rated by the network to accommodate parents with limited data

evidence.quote: Yes. And could it be zero-rated? I heard some schools have arranged that with the networks.

proposals.statement: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see information about that learner, with court orders for some divorced parents

evidence.quote: Only a learner's own parents or guardians may see anything about that learner.
And with some divorced parents, one of them may not see anything at all. There's a court order on about a dozen files.

proposals.statement: The portal should use the school's maroon color instead of a generic blue

evidence.quote: Oh, and please use the school's maroon, not some generic blue.

proposals.statement: The portal should have big, clear text for parents with eye problems and accessibility for screen readers

evidence.quote: And big, clear text. Some of our parents struggle with their eyesight, and we have a blind parent on the PTA who uses a screen reader.

proposals.statement: The portal should support isiZulu for notices and main screens to accommodate grandparents who are more comfortable in isiZulu

evidence.quote: English is the school's language, but a lot of our grandparents look after the children, and they're more comfortable in isiZulu. If the notices and the main screens could be in isiZulu too, that would mean a lot.

proposals.statement: The finance committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand rand for the first year, but the board must approve it

evidence.quote: The finance committee has proposed two hundred and fifty thousand rand for the first year, all in. But the board has to approve it, and they only meet on the twenty-eighth of January.

proposals.statement: The portal must be ready by the term two report date, which is the twenty-sixth of June

evidence.quote: The term two reports go out on the twenty-sixth of June. We'd like parents to get those through the portal.

proposals.statement: The school has only one IT person who works two days a week, so if the portal breaks on report night, there's no one to fix it

evidence.quote: Me, honestly. I'm the only IT person, and only two days a week. If something breaks on report night, there's nobody.

proposals.statement: The school wants to start with a trial of one grade's term one reports in April to test the portal

evidence.quote: Let's do grade eight in April as the trial.

proposals.statement: The portal must be hosted in South Africa as per the board's decision

evidence.quote: The board said it must be hosted in South Africa. That came out of the last board meeting.

proposals.statement: If the first report day goes badly, parents lose trust in the portal immediately

evidence.quote: A risk I see is that if the first report day goes badly, parents lose trust in the portal straight away.

proposals.statement: SchoolBase 7 does not have an API, and the supplier has not responded to a query about it

evidence.quote: Not that I know of. I've asked the supplier and they haven't answered yet.

proposals.statement: The portal's data must be zero-rated by the network to accommodate parents with limited data

evidence.quote: Yes. And could it be zero-rated? I heard some schools have arranged that with the networks.

proposals.statement: The portal must be able to handle the current parent count of sixteen hundred and fifty, including families with both parents and grandparents listed

evidence.quote: Ayanda, I've just looked in SchoolBase while we were talking. It's not fourteen hundred parent contacts, it's about sixteen hundred and fifty. A lot of families have both parents and a grandparent listed.
